summary: Independent Q6 walk at 1320dba: the public operator plans Terraform, rebuilds fleetctl, and commits through a hash-checked control plane. Go packages implement validation, IPAM sqlite lookup, identity, placement, pilot/wave rollout, volumes, journal, fence, drift, and import with real branching. Starter spec packages are imported then discarded, which is a coupled defect rather than dead files. Honest reachable runtime/config is above the 3000-line strict floor. IPAM 12000-row catalog is consumed by eligibility checks. TOY_LOGIC_RISK LOW; PADDING_RISK MEDIUM.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges complexity, reachability, coupling, and padding. Complexity Governor PASS is not copied as a conclusion. large_system_strict needs >=3000 substantive reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk.
Software/Systems; artifacts include controller, internal, terraform, scripts, bin, go.mod/sum; separate verifier; agent timeout 10800.
Verifies control-plane hash, terraform init/validate/plan, builds fleetctl, apply, inventory GET, writes rollout-report.json READY only when AMI, IMDS, counts, and digests agree.
plan/apply/validate CLI: journal repair, controller.Render, control-plane Commit, durable state/journal, exit 3 on lost reply.
modernc sqlite catalog: EligibleAppSubnet and ApprovedImage are live lookups, not fixtures in RAM only.
Starter Refresh discards rolloutspec.Refresh and emits rolling_replace. The discarded spec path is imported; wiring it is the repair, not unused file padding.
Real AWS resources: launch template, ASG, SG, IAM role/policy, EBS, attachments, log group. Starter uses latest AMI alias, optional IMDS, SSH/world, unencrypted disks.
HTTP inventory/commit with in-progress owner fencing and lost-reply 503. Baked at /opt/ec2-controlplane with sha256 pin.
subnets and images tables consumed by ipam.store; seed is 12000 subnet rows plus images.

findings.why_it_matters: Several *spec packages contain the correct algorithm and are called with discarded results. That inflates counted LOC, but it is the observable starter defect (partial wiring fails F2P), not unreachable clone files.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep discarded-result defects; do not add more unused packages.
findings.regression_risk: Removing spec packages would drop counted LOC and remove a legitimate repair surface.

do_not_change: Do not alter solver-visible production/runtime/configuration/data surfaces on the strength of this Q6 PASS; such a change would stale this review.
Do not use this Q6 result as evidence for Q4 spec-test alignment or later acceptance roles.
Do not treat Complexity Governor output as the basis for this verdict.
